story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 4 — The Seal That Wasn't Used
scene_purpose: Inspect Queen Lysara's actual personal royal seal under normal Crown procedure; establish that the physical seal is present, intact, recognized, and still answers normally for Lysara; compare legitimate and suspect authority responses; review custody and recent legitimate use without manufacturing a guilty palace suspect; establish that no simple documented theft-and-return window explains the suspect orders; preserve both unauthorized physical access and unknown nonstandard magical invocation as unproven possibilities; identify Nimera Pellan in the Old City archives as the next useful Card expert; authorize controlled comparison evidence and lawful Old City access; then split the investigation so Maevra stays with Mirena while Cyanis, Ilyra, and Torren go to find Nimera.

sections: Beat 4 — The Seal That Wasn't Used

scene_context_seed.location_name: Caelora palace restricted royal verification / seal-custody room
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Move out of the audience chamber into a practical secure verification space. This is normal Crown procedure under abnormal circumstances, not a sinister vault. Appropriate staff may be physically present but need not become voiced suspects. Use portraits + dialogue box with simple field placement and only the minimum physical actions required to produce/verify the seal and records.

required_story_beats: The actual physical personal royal seal is produced under normal Crown custody procedure and recognized as the current real seal.
The seal is physically present and intact; there is no obvious crude replacement or damage explanation.
Known legitimate recent royal documents and/or a controlled verification establish that the actual seal still answers normally for Lysara.
The suspect Card-transport orders and legitimate comparison material show the same recognized core royal magical authority character strongly enough that ordinary visual forgery remains inadequate.
Custody records, recent legitimate uses, access, and relevant staff records are reviewed without treating proximity to the seal as guilt.
No simple documented theft-and-return window is found; custody is not declared infallible, so covert physical access remains possible.
Unknown nonstandard magical invocation also remains possible, but is not established as fact or favored over physical access.
The Queen's actual seal remains secured in Crown custody and does not travel with the party.
Mirena identifies Nimera Pellan as a leading Card scholar currently working in the Old City archives.
The Crown authorizes bounded seal-comparison evidence and lawful access to the restricted Old City archive areas.
At the end of the beat, Maevra stays in Caelora with Mirena on the royal-seal/Crown-record investigation while Cyanis, Ilyra, and Torren go to the Old City to find Nimera.
